pairs.question: Quid ergo interest inter pressuram et scandalum?
pairs.answer: In pressura parabas seruare patientiam, tenere constantiam, non relinquere fidem, non consentire peccato.
pairs.derivation: Augustine poses the question and answers it himself. Answer ends at the first full stop, where the operative distinction is given; the next sentence ('hoc si seruas...') turns to elaborating consequences (the olive-press image) rather than defining the difference, so it is cut. No framing to strip; first-word capitalization normalized.
